Business.title: Business
Business.description: Represents a local business or community initiative affected by an emergency requiring solidarity donations or sales support.

id.description: Unique identifier for the business document

category.description: Category of the business (e.g. Alimentos, Ropa, Hogar, Servicios)

needType.description: Primary need type: donation for relief/reconstruction or sale for products

fullDescription.description: Detailed background story and damage report

image.description: URL or WebP data of the main business cover image

contact.description: Direct contact phone and verified Colombian payment gateways (Nequi, Daviplata, Bancolombia, Bre-B)

socials.description: Social media links and web presence

products.description: List of up to 5 optimized product/damage photos

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who registered the business

/businesses/{businessId}.description: Collection of verified businesses and community relief initiatives
